title: Concept: pip certificate path configured but empty
description: pip.conf declares an empty `cert` setting, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The client falls back to whatever trust store the runtime carries, so the accepted index certificates are unspecified.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pip.conf (pypi).
risk: The client falls back to whatever trust store the runtime carries, so the accepted index certificates are unspecified.
